template_management_description: Template management will allow you to create, save, and apply shift demand patterns across different time periods. This feature includes template creation from existing data, manual template editing, and intelligent application with conflict resolution.
no_templates_description: Create your first template to save and reuse shift demand patterns.
choose_template_from_list: Choose a template from the list on the left to view its details.
standard_template_usage_info: This standard template will apply the same weekly pattern throughout the selected date range.
even_odd_template_usage_info: This even/odd template will alternate between even and odd week patterns based on ISO week numbers.
template_creation_description: The template creation interface will allow you to create new templates from scratch or existing demand patterns.
template_application_description: The template application interface will allow you to apply templates to specific date ranges with conflict resolution.
template_editor_description: The template editor will allow you to create and modify template demand patterns with an intuitive grid interface.
select_template_description: Choose a template from the list on the left to view its details and make edits.
confirm_delete_template: Are you sure you want to delete the template "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
template_name_too_short: Template name must be at least 3 characters
template_description_placeholder: Enter a description for this template (optional)
